title: Human Eye - Structure and Function
body:
Study the cross-sectional diagram of the human eye:

```
[HUMAN EYE CROSS-SECTION]

                     CONJUNCTIVA
                         |
    Light ---->    [A]CORNEA
                         |
                    AQUEOUS HUMOUR
                         |
                    [B]PUPIL (in IRIS)
                         |
                    [C]LENS
                         |
                   VITREOUS HUMOUR
                         |
                    [D]RETINA (contains rods & cones)
                         |
                    [E]OPTIC NERVE
                         |
                       BRAIN

    CILIARY MUSCLES control lens shape
    SUSPENSORY LIGAMENTS attach lens to ciliary body
```

Identify the structures labeled A through E and explain the function of structure C in focusing light.
